title: Cernan's telepathic message on Apollo 17, per Takano Jouen
place_text: En route to the Moon, Apollo 17

tellings.quote: But I guess his reason for there never being anything after that was that when he was on the way to the moon in Apollo 17, he got some sort of telepathic message saying, "We don't really want you here."

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, relays a claim credited to a person named Takano Jouen about Eugene Cernan, an astronaut on Apollo 17, the 1972 mission to the Moon after which no one went back. According to this account, on the way to the Moon Cernan received some kind of telepathic message saying, "We don't really want you here." It is offered as the reason the Moon trips stopped.
